messages:
Nora (eng-platform): FYI we're proposing a v2 route header that carries structured attributes (tenant, affinity, hints). This will change hashing and could affect SDKs. Need quick compatibility plan.
Ben (devex): Console: we'll need a migration tile and banner. Also a mapping job to reconcile historical route tags.
Ivy (sdk): TS/Py can handle dual headers; Go needs an explicit RoundTripper shim. Suggest shipping a helper that emits both legacy `x-route` and new `x-route-v2`.
Marco (qa): Test matrix: py3.10/3.11, node18/20, go1.20/1.21. Add fuzz tests for hashing canonicalization and a batch-size header limit check.
Omar (infra): I'll put a gateway shim behind a feature flag that accepts both formats, normalizes downstream, and tags traces with `route.migration=shim`. We'll sample telemetry at 1% for normal and 100% for errors.
Nora (eng-platform): Rollout gates: canary 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% over 72h. Pause on >2% p50 latency regression or >5% per-route cost delta.
Ivy (sdk): Plan for SDKs: minor release with opt-in dual mode + docs; after 30 days flip default to v2 if metrics look good; provide env var to force legacy.
Marco (qa): Also ensure quota buckets don't double-count when hashing shifts. Add integration scenarios with quota ledgers.
Ben (devex): UX: Admin -> SDK Migrations card: percent migrated, top tenants still on legacy, quick copy-paste per-SDK snippet. Email owners when 90% reached or 10% remain.
Omar (infra): deploy-bot: shim-canary deploy scheduled once PR merges; will log when header sizes get truncated. Alert if >0.05% requests truncated.
deploy-bot: shim-canary deployed to staging at 3%. No increase in 5xx in last 20m. :thumbsup:
Nora (eng-platform): Action items: Omar gateway shim + telemetry, Ivy SDK helpers + examples, Marco QA matrix, Ben Console tile mock. Revisit after 24h of canary. Thanks all! :rocket:
